quote: The signed contract provides, in its first phase, for the recovery of 432 MW at Tocoma, through the rehabilitation of Units 1 and 2, and 240 MW at Macagua, through Units 4, 5, and 6, bringing the total to 672 MW within a 24-month period.
note: Opened IMPSA English company press 2026-10-04; ownership via IAF stated on same page.
